rules.name: Active Directory Domain Enumeration
rules.description: Detect AD enumeration via LDAP queries, DSQuery, BloodHound collection
rules.query: SELECT "siem_reconnaissance_reconnaissance_117", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0
